payload.summary_en: RCEP Chapter 3 defines originating goods, cumulation and associated operational conditions. Preferential treatment requires the relevant product-specific rule and importing-party implementation, not merely a Chinese shipping address.

payload.cash_effect: Keep the preference conditional until the evidence and destination rate are established.

payload.title: DAP与DDP：谁承担进口清关
payload.summary_zh: ICC公开解释区分DAP与DDP的进口清关责任；采用DDP前应确认卖方在目的国是否能够履行相关义务，并核对合同约定地点和版本。
payload.summary_en: ICC explains that DAP and DDP allocate import-clearance responsibilities differently. Destination rules may prevent a seller from undertaking the obligations expected under DDP.
payload.tradex_workflow: Read the contract before assigning tax and clearance costs; ask who can act as importer and which costs were actually agreed.
payload.cash_effect: Only put taxes and duties into the exporter’s cash plan when its contractual responsibility is established.
